verdict.rationale: Workable markets an autonomous Workable Agent that sources, screens and qualifies candidates and hands over a shortlist. Webhook subscriptions let external services react to candidate events, so background automations are possible but rely on the user's own tooling. There is no evidence of a native, user-configurable automation builder. Missing for 10: a documented in-product rule/trigger automation builder, details on configuring and scheduling the Agent's background runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it runs autonomously.
